South Korea's AI chip boom fuels wealth surge and future fund plans

South Korea is experiencing a significant economic boom driven by its AI chip industry, with companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix at the forefront. This surge has led to increased wealth, though questions remain about equitable distribution. The government is reportedly planning to establish a future growth fund, potentially financed by a chip tax windfall, to further invest in the sector.
